description: Source code for the Graph class and related functions in the torch::nativert::graph namespace, implementing graph construction, manipulation, serialization, and deserialization.

classes.name: Graph
classes.description: Represents a computational graph with nodes and values, supporting creation, insertion, removal, serialization, deserialization, and device placement.

classes.name: Node
classes.description: Represents a node in the graph with target operation, inputs, outputs, and attributes.

classes.name: Value
classes.description: Represents a value in the graph, which can be an input, output, constant, or intermediate.

classes.name: Type
classes.description: Represents the data type of a Value, including tensor types, lists, and custom objects.

classes.name: Constant
classes.description: Represents a constant value, including numbers, strings, tensors, and subgraphs.

classes.name: NamedArgument
classes.description: Represents a named argument for node inputs or attributes.

classes.name: Attribute
classes.description: Represents an attribute of a node, with a name and value.

methods.name: Graph::getUniqueValueName
methods.description: Generates a unique name for a new value.

methods.name: Graph::addValue
methods.description: Adds a new value to the graph with an optional name, type, and associated node.

methods.name: Graph::addInput
methods.description: Adds an input value to the graph.

methods.name: Graph::addOutput
methods.description: Adds an output value to the graph.

methods.name: Graph::createNode
methods.description: Creates a new node without inserting it into the graph.

methods.name: Graph::insertBefore
methods.description: Inserts a node before a specified node.

methods.name: Graph::insert
methods.description: Inserts a node at the current insertion point.

methods.name: Graph::insertAfter
methods.description: Inserts a node after a specified node.

methods.name: Graph::insertNode
methods.description: Creates and inserts a new node into the graph.

methods.name: Graph::nodeAfter
methods.description: Returns the node after a given node.

methods.name: Graph::nodeBefore
methods.description: Returns the node before a given node.

methods.name: Graph::removeNode
methods.description: Removes a node from the graph.

methods.name: Graph::removeValue
methods.description: Removes a value from the graph.

methods.name: Graph::replaceAllUses
methods.description: Replaces all uses of a value with another value.

methods.name: Graph::replaceAllUsesAfterNode
methods.description: Replaces all uses of a value after a specific node.

methods.name: Graph::applyDevicePlacement
methods.description: Applies device placement to all nodes and tensors in the graph.

methods.name: Graph::overrideWeightsDevice
methods.description: Overrides device placement for weights and tensors.

methods.name: Graph::cleanupDeadNodes
methods.description: Removes dead nodes not reachable from output.

methods.name: Graph::lint
methods.description: Performs consistency checks on the graph.

methods.name: Graph::finalize
methods.description: Finalizes the graph, building output views.

methods.name: Graph::createListPack
methods.description: Creates a list pack node from input values.

methods.name: Graph::createOptionalListPack
methods.description: Creates an optional list pack node.

methods.name: Graph::createConstantSymIntValue
methods.description: Creates a constant symbolic integer value.

methods.name: Graph::getValue
methods.description: Retrieves a value by name.

methods.name: Graph::tryGetValue
methods.description: Attempts to retrieve a value by name, returns nullptr if not found.

methods.name: Graph::renumberValues
methods.description: Renumbers value IDs in the graph.
